Description.value: An in-game settings window for KitsuneUI (Esc menu > KitsuneUI): toolbelt slot numbers, enemy health bar, trader job tiles, whole backpack without scrolling, idle fade, a minimap with markers, a horde night countdown, crafting progress, glass strength, colour presets, bar text, text size, Move HUD to drag, resize or hide every HUD piece (grid, snap, reset), and layout profiles you can export and share. Saved per player. Needs KitsuneUI. Contains a DLL: play with EAC off, and install on the server and every client.
